title: Decision: Store errors map to 500, not 401 (verify in extractor)
description: Why this is good: The extractor mirrors the authorize() function's error handling: store errors return Err(CallerRejection::Internal), which maps to 500 (Internal Server Error), while actual authorization denials return Err(CallerRejection::Unauthorized), which maps to 401. This distinction is critical for operational observability: a 500 signals operators that the system is broken (DB unreachable, disk full, etc.), while 401 signals that the caller is not permitted. If both were 401, operators would be blind to transient failures and would assume the system is working when it's actually down. This pattern is enforced at the type level: there are only two rejection types, and each maps to the correct HTTP status.
